title: clerodendrum cephalanthum subsp. montanum
intro: Clerodendrum cephalanthum subsp. montanum, commonly known as the Mountain Glory Bower, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae. It is a shrub native to the tropical regions of Asia, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The Mountain Glory Bower is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, skin infections, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Clerodendrum cephalanthum subsp. montanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions of modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.
